rulesets.name: Cloudflare Managed Ruleset Execution
rulesets.description: Enforce Cloudflare Managed Ruleset on api.yourhospital.com to mitigate zero-day and common web vulnerabilities

rulesets.name: Cloudflare OWASP Core Ruleset Execution
rulesets.description: Enforce OWASP ModSecurity Core Ruleset with anomaly scoring on api.yourhospital.com to protect healthcare endpoints

rate_limiting_rules.name: Zone WAF Layer 1: Auth & Token Rate Limiting
rate_limiting_rules.expression: http.host eq "api.yourhospital.com" and (http.request.uri.path starts_with "/api/v1/auth" or http.request.uri.path starts_with "/api/v1/exchange-token")
rate_limiting_rules.description: Zone WAF Layer 1: Throttle authentication and token exchange endpoints to max 30 req/60s per source IP

rate_limiting_rules.name: Zone WAF Layer 1: Clinical Records Burst Protection
rate_limiting_rules.description: Zone WAF Layer 1: Throttle clinical record access and upload requests to max 60 req/60s per source IP

rate_limiting_rules.name: Zone WAF Layer 1: General API Volumetric Protection
rate_limiting_rules.description: Zone WAF Layer 1: Protect api.yourhospital.com against volumetric DDoS and scraping with 600 req/60s per source IP cap
